title: thymus hirtus subsp. serpylloides
intro: Thymus hirtus subsp. serpylloides, commonly known as Alpine Thyme or Serpyllo Thyme, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it an effective treatment for wounds, respiratory issues, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Thymus hirtus subsp. serpylloides include stimulating the immune system, reducing inflammation, and acting as an expectorant to relieve respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include thymol, carvacrol, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
